gtfs.note: stop_id = DataSF stopid; routes served + nearest same-route alternative stop (straight-line metres, slight understatement of the walk).

encampment.label: 311 encampment & unhoused reports
encampment.filter: (service_name IN ('Encampment','Encampments') OR (service_name='General Request' AND lower(service_subtype) LIKE '%homeless%'))
encampment.caveat: Community 311 reports of encampments (tents/structures) unioned with the unhoused-individual requests SF split out in mid-2025. Counts who reports, not harm; a burst can be one neighbour. Attached to the nearest stop within 25 m of the geocoded point — 311 points snap to the intersection, so part of a stop's count is the corner's count.
encampment.stop_query_template: https://data.sf.gov/resource/vw6y-z8j6.json?$query=SELECT date_trunc_ym(requested_datetime) AS month, count(*) AS reports WHERE (service_name IN ('Encampment','Encampments') OR (service_name='General Request' AND lower(service_subtype) LIKE '%homeless%')) AND requested_datetime >= '2023-01-01T00:00:00' AND within_circle(point, {lat}, {lng}, 25) GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
encampment.stop_total_template: https://data.sf.gov/resource/vw6y-z8j6.json?$query=SELECT count(*) AS reports WHERE (service_name IN ('Encampment','Encampments') OR (service_name='General Request' AND lower(service_subtype) LIKE '%homeless%')) AND requested_datetime >= '{from}T00:00:00' AND requested_datetime < '{to}T00:00:00' AND within_circle(point, {lat}, {lng}, 25)

shelter_maint.label: 311 shelter maintenance (cleaning · graffiti · damage · litter)
shelter_maint.filter: (upper(service_subtype) LIKE '%TRANSIT_SHELTER%' OR upper(service_subtype) LIKE '%TRANSIT SHELTER%' OR upper(service_details) LIKE '%TRANSIT_SHELTER%' OR upper(service_details) LIKE '%TRANSIT SHELTER%')
shelter_maint.caveat: 311 cases whose subtype/details are explicitly tagged to a transit shelter or platform: Street & Sidewalk Cleaning, Graffiti, Damaged Property, Litter Receptacle. About the structure itself — the public maintenance load, not presence.
shelter_maint.stop_query_template: https://data.sf.gov/resource/vw6y-z8j6.json?$query=SELECT date_trunc_ym(requested_datetime) AS month, count(*) AS reports WHERE (upper(service_subtype) LIKE '%TRANSIT_SHELTER%' OR upper(service_subtype) LIKE '%TRANSIT SHELTER%' OR upper(service_details) LIKE '%TRANSIT_SHELTER%' OR upper(service_details) LIKE '%TRANSIT SHELTER%') AND requested_datetime >= '2023-01-01T00:00:00' AND within_circle(point, {lat}, {lng}, 25) GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
shelter_maint.stop_total_template: https://data.sf.gov/resource/vw6y-z8j6.json?$query=SELECT count(*) AS reports WHERE (upper(service_subtype) LIKE '%TRANSIT_SHELTER%' OR upper(service_subtype) LIKE '%TRANSIT SHELTER%' OR upper(service_details) LIKE '%TRANSIT_SHELTER%' OR upper(service_details) LIKE '%TRANSIT SHELTER%') AND requested_datetime >= '{from}T00:00:00' AND requested_datetime < '{to}T00:00:00' AND within_circle(point, {lat}, {lng}, 25)

cfs_presence.label: 911 unhoused-presence calls (Sit/Lie + Homeless Complaint)
cfs_presence.filter: call_type_final_desc IN ('SIT/LIE ENFORCEMENT','HOMELESS COMPLAINT') AND onview_flag IN ('N','HSOC') AND dup_cad_number IS NULL
cfs_presence.caveat: Community-reported SFPD calls (onview N or HSOC, SF-flagged dups dropped). 911 points are intersection centroids, so calls attach to every stop at the same intersection and are labelled 'at this intersection', never 'at this stop'. Mid-block stops get none.
cfs_presence.stop_query_template: https://data.sf.gov/resource/2zdj-bwza.json?$query=SELECT date_trunc_ym(received_datetime) AS month, count(*) AS reports WHERE call_type_final_desc IN ('SIT/LIE ENFORCEMENT','HOMELESS COMPLAINT') AND onview_flag IN ('N','HSOC') AND dup_cad_number IS NULL AND received_datetime >= '2023-01-01T00:00:00' AND intersection_name = '{intersection}' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
cfs_presence.stop_total_template: https://data.sf.gov/resource/2zdj-bwza.json?$query=SELECT count(*) AS reports WHERE call_type_final_desc IN ('SIT/LIE ENFORCEMENT','HOMELESS COMPLAINT') AND onview_flag IN ('N','HSOC') AND dup_cad_number IS NULL AND received_datetime >= '{from}T00:00:00' AND received_datetime < '{to}T00:00:00' AND intersection_name = '{intersection}'

cfs_drug.label: 911 drug-activity reports (Suspicious Person, drug-noted)
cfs_drug.filter: call_type_final_desc = 'SUSPICIOUS PERSON' AND onview_flag IN ('N','HSOC') AND (upper(call_type_original_notes) LIKE '%DRUG%' OR upper(call_type_final_notes) LIKE '%DRUG%' OR upper(call_type_original_notes) LIKE '%DEALER%' OR upper(call_type_final_notes) LIKE '%DEALER%' OR upper(call_type_original_notes) LIKE '%SALES%' OR upper(call_type_final_notes) LIKE '%SALES%' OR upper(call_type_original_notes) LIKE '%METH%' OR upper(call_type_final_notes) LIKE '%METH%')
cfs_drug.caveat: Community 'Suspicious Person' calls whose notes mention drugs/dealing/meth — the drug dashboard's headline channel (~95% drug-related). Intersection-resolution like the other 911 signal.
cfs_drug.stop_query_template: https://data.sf.gov/resource/2zdj-bwza.json?$query=SELECT date_trunc_ym(received_datetime) AS month, count(*) AS reports WHERE call_type_final_desc = 'SUSPICIOUS PERSON' AND onview_flag IN ('N','HSOC') AND (upper(call_type_original_notes) LIKE '%DRUG%' OR upper(call_type_final_notes) LIKE '%DRUG%' OR upper(call_type_original_notes) LIKE '%DEALER%' OR upper(call_type_final_notes) LIKE '%DEALER%' OR upper(call_type_original_notes) LIKE '%SALES%' OR upper(call_type_final_notes) LIKE '%SALES%' OR upper(call_type_original_notes) LIKE '%METH%' OR upper(call_type_final_notes) LIKE '%METH%') AND received_datetime >= '2023-01-01T00:00:00' AND intersection_name = '{intersection}' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
cfs_drug.stop_total_template: https://data.sf.gov/resource/2zdj-bwza.json?$query=SELECT count(*) AS reports WHERE call_type_final_desc = 'SUSPICIOUS PERSON' AND onview_flag IN ('N','HSOC') AND (upper(call_type_original_notes) LIKE '%DRUG%' OR upper(call_type_final_notes) LIKE '%DRUG%' OR upper(call_type_original_notes) LIKE '%DEALER%' OR upper(call_type_final_notes) LIKE '%DEALER%' OR upper(call_type_original_notes) LIKE '%SALES%' OR upper(call_type_final_notes) LIKE '%SALES%' OR upper(call_type_original_notes) LIKE '%METH%' OR upper(call_type_final_notes) LIKE '%METH%') AND received_datetime >= '{from}T00:00:00' AND received_datetime < '{to}T00:00:00' AND intersection_name = '{intersection}'
